query: I just discovered while debugging that without return_exceptions=True, asyncio.gather cancels the rest of the coroutines on the first exception. Record this.

While integrating with the Kiwoom OpenAPI, I found that for TR requests, the continuation key must be a space rather than an empty string, otherwise it doesn't work. Not in the official docs. Save this as a lesson.
/learned
When using FakeTimeProvider, Timer callbacks didn't run. After Advance(), you must add Task.Delay(1) for the callback to fire. Record this.
I learned that setting chunk_time_interval too small when creating a TimescaleDB hypertable degrades performance. Record this knowledge.
From this Task I learned that serializing in Dapr Actor with circular references causes infinite loops. Record the lesson.
I should remember this stumble — in LS Securities WebSocket, I assumed SC0 TR code was execution data, but it's actually order-fill.
Record this. When creating a Redis Streams consumer group, omitting MKSTREAM throws an error if the stream doesn't exist.
gotcha! In EF Core, fields with HasConversion don't get server-side evaluation in LINQ — they fall back to client-side. Be careful.
Just learned that ML.NET LightGBM doesn't run with the default packages on ARM64 — needs a separate native build. Record it.
